produces.meaning: the doctrine ruleset is frozen, so a gauge run measures against a fixed rule set

evidence.why: lehre-pin writes .github/workflows/lehre.yml, edits to pyproject.toml or linter config, and test files -- all at the host repo's own CI paths, none plugin-owned or predictable. lehre's only real marker writer is lehre_cli.py close -> .lehre/units/<id>.done, and that belongs to lehre-validate, not lehre-pin.
